6.characters: The staff's contact directory. The nav shape is the Campaign set's: a sub-tab strip of Overview | Reports | Contacts under the page title, with the existing /manage grid as the third tab rather than the whole page. Every control is taken from the running folk_hkmc app — the same header pill, the same tab strip, the same scope switch, the same grid toolbar and table, the same tokens.
